profile.label: Pilot moves v1
profile.selectionBasis: Budgets were proposed from the historical one-direction screen and are held fixed for the directed-swap rescreen. Human acceptance remains open.

changes.hypothesis: Test a modest two-move trim while checking player-visible headroom.
Test one-move relief at a historically constrained level.
Test a modest pre-five-color challenge without changing objectives or mechanics.
Offer two more moves for the first five-color boss; its 90-second controllable-time clock remains an independent constraint.
Test less post-boss slack; confirm remaining headroom with players.
Test a six-move trim while retaining the authored 90-second timer.
Test removal of the second large unused-move discontinuity.
Test a four-move trim without changing the tighter 75-second clock.

model.actionSpace: Both directions of each legal swap, deduplicated by ordered endpoints; each legal power-up tap once.
model.foresight: No future refill, cascade, or engine RNG inspection. Power-up target uncertainty uses a fixed independent footprint sampler.
model.bossClock: Task 5 candidate: visible controllable time only; forced presentation and hidden time excluded.
model.presentation: Nominal ordered phase model using current pure timing helpers and power-up budgets, not measured per-run browser time.
model.sampling: Production cohorts hold the app retry seed fixed while policy choices vary. Sensitivity cohorts vary both seeds. Wilson intervals are conditional bot-screening summaries, not human win rates.
